Name: Simple Faithful Plus Portrait
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=4]Simple Faithful+ Portraits[/size][/b]

A fresh look for familiar faces.
Simple Faithful+ Portraits brings detailed HD artwork to all 48 original Stardew Valley portrait subjects. Recognizable hairstyles, colours and character details keep each person familiar, while seasonal clothing adds variety throughout the year.

[b]FEATURES[/b]
• HD portraits for all 48 original portrait subjects.
• Spring, summer, fall and winter outfits.
• Seasonal clothing carried across ordinary facial expressions.
• Supported special outfits, including beachwear and work clothing.
• Close bust framing designed for Stardew Valley’s portrait windows.
• Built-in HD rendering and portrait preloading.
• Individual character toggles for mixing portrait sets.
• Optional Generic Mod Config Menu settings.
• Settings translated into all 12 built-in game languages.

[b]SEASONAL PORTRAITS[/b]
Seasonal portraits are enabled by default. Characters wear outfits suited to spring, summer, fall and winter, with their seasonal clothing retained as expressions change.
Prefer the standard outfit set? Turn off Seasonal portraits in the settings.

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6 on desktop.
• SMAPI 4.2.0 or newer.
Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration.
Content Patcher, Portraiture and HD Portraits are not required.

[b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Simple Faithful+ Portraits.[/*]
[*]Place the SimpleFaithful+Portraits folder inside your game’s Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]When updating, close the game and replace the previous mod folder. Keep your config.json if you want to preserve your settings.
[b]
SETTINGS[/b]
Enable or disable the mod, switch seasonal portraits on or off, choose whether to replace supported special outfits, and enable or disable individual characters.
Without Generic Mod Config Menu, edit the config.json created after the first launch.
[b]
COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Portrait rendering has been checked with the vanilla interface, Simple UI Themes and Simple UI Themes 2.
If another mod replaces the same character’s portraits, disable that character in this mod’s settings to use the other portrait set.
Expansion NPCs and unsupported custom portrait layouts retain their loaded artwork.
[b]
FEEDBACK[/b]
If you notice an incorrect expression, outfit mismatch or framing issue, please include the character’s name, season, screenshot and SMAPI log when reporting it.
[b]
CREDITS[/b]
Stardew Valley and original character designs: ConcernedApe.
Mod development and portrait preparation: Xsyy.
Portrait artwork uses AI-assisted generation and editing.
